from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from main import app, get_items


def fake_items() -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [
        {"id": 1, "name": "Microscope", "quantity": 4, "internal_note": "repair"},
    ]


def test_list_items_hides_internal_fields() -> None:
    app.dependency_overrides[get_items] = fake_items
    try:
        client = TestClient(app)
        response = client.get("/items")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert response.json() == [{"id": 1, "name": "Microscope", "quantity": 4}]
    finally:
        app.dependency_overrides.clear()


def test_missing_item_returns_404() -> None:
    app.dependency_overrides[get_items] = fake_items
    try:
        client = TestClient(app)
        response = client.get("/items/99")
        assert response.status_code == 404
    finally:
        app.dependency_overrides.clear()
